values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Mississippi Hub expansion is tied to LNG exports because a Pipeline and Gas Journal article from April 2025 on the FERC approval says the company cites growing demand for LNG exports as a driver. The article also names LNG and power generation demand in the Southeast as the reason for the expansion.

verifications.note: Article on the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approval of the Enstor Mississippi Hub expansion. Says the expansion supports growing LNG and power generation demand, and that the company cites demand for LNG exports. The page names the Mississippi Hub storage expansion, which this row describes.

records.researcher_notes: Enstor's Mississippi Hub expansion adds 33.5 billion cubic feet of storage and is the project behind this row. The LNG tie rests on one trade article that names LNG exports as a demand driver, so the tier is medium. No LNG terminal is named in the sources, so the terminal cell is blank. The row is a storage expansion rather than a pipeline, so a reviewer may want to confirm it belongs in this flag.
